def _pipe_pager(text_or_generator, cmd):
    import subprocess
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True, stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert proc.stdin is not None
    try:

            proc.stdin.write(text.encode('utf-8'))
    except (IOError, KeyboardInterrupt):
        pass
    else:
        proc.stdin.close()
    proc.wait()
```
